title: Artifact
description: A view built from records for a reader: a document, deck, dashboard, design, page or file. Records are the source of truth and are never what gets published; artifacts are what gets published, and each names the records it was built from, at the revision it read, so naive check can say when one has gone stale.

url.description: Where it is published or kept

function.description: The venture function whose action built it

action.description: The action that built it, as in the choosing-artifacts map

audience.description: Who it is for: the founder, the team, investors, the public

published.description: It has gone out to its audience; a person decides that

record.description: The record's logical path in the venture, such as foundation/problem.json

sha256.description: The record's content hash when the artifact was built

output.description: The built output, as naive publish build wrote it: what a channel publishes
